notes: Added foundry/FEHA_GRENADE_CATALOG.js as the canonical physical grenade data/migration layer for all 18 Foundry grenade items.
Regular, Homing, and Sticky delivery variants now have distinct mechanics instead of sharing generic damage text.
Biohazard, Cutting, EMP, Flash, Frag, Incendiary, Ozob's Nose, Recon, and Smoke payloads now have differentiated effects and explicit grenadeSchema flags for future automation.
Existing grenade Mk, market price, availability, one-use identity, item art, and catalog placement are preserved.
ADK DEV LOADER now preflights the grenade module and performs one idempotent GM-side migration across world and owned grenade items.
